diagram_previews.alt: Coordinate axes with the parabolas y^2 = 4x (a = 1) and y^2 = 12x (a = 3) opening to the right, their foci marked on the x-axis. From each focus a blue segment of length k goes to a red point on its parabola, and a red dashed ellipse through the origin passes through both red points.
